title: The Foyer
hiddenNote: // built in a hurry. looks fine on my screen.

ghosts.name: Invisible
ghosts.line: I couldn't tell where I was.
ghosts.lesson: A link needs a visible ring when it has focus. Show one with the focus-visible rule. People who use a keyboard rely on it to find their place.
ghosts.releaseLine: Now I can see where I am.

repairs.label: Make the link text bold
repairs.why: Bold text does not show where the focus is.

repairs.label: Enlarge the link text
repairs.why: A bigger link still has no ring when it has focus.

ghosts.name: Faceless
ghosts.line: Nobody told me what this button did.
ghosts.lesson: A button that holds only an icon needs a name. The name tells people who use a screen reader what the button does.
ghosts.releaseLine: Now I know what it does.

repairs.label: Give the button an accessible name
Add a magnifier picture to the button
repairs.why: A picture has no name for people who use a screen reader.

repairs.label: Colour the button blue
repairs.why: Colour does not give the button a name.

ghosts.name: Hallway
ghosts.line: I had to walk past every door.
ghosts.lesson: A long list of links comes before the main part. A skip link lets people who use a keyboard jump straight to it.

repairs.label: Hide the menu links
repairs.why: Hiding the menu removes the links instead of letting people skip them.

repairs.label: Add a Top link at the end
repairs.why: A link at the end does not skip the links before it.
